ctgov.note: All 10 sponsor-led trials are COMPLETED (registration trials for now-approved products)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Journey Medical is a commercial-stage dermatology specialty pharma company (controlled subsidiary of Fortress Biotech). Its strategy is to in-license/acquire FDA-approved or near-approval products and commercialize them via its sales force. All clinicaltrials.gov sponsor-led studies are COMPLETED — they were registration studies for marketed products: Emrosi/DFD-29 (rosacea, FDA-approved Nov 2024), Qbrexza/DRM04 glycopyrronium (axillary hyperhidrosis, approved). Currently marketed products include Emrosi, Qbrexza, Accutane, Amzeeq, Zilxi, Targadox, Exelderm, Luxamend. No active sponsor-led P1/P2/P3 trials are in progress.
